correctness.rationale: The proof splits all congruences at the fiber relation, proves the Boolean lower interval via prime-order translation invariance, proves the partition upper interval via cross-fiber collapse, and counts subgroup congruences exactly. Both quandle operations and their two argument positions were checked by direct exhaustive enumeration for p=2,3; all Boolean cases at p=5 were checked. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.
